item.title: For snowboarder Jake Canter, an Olympic bronze medal is the prize after a near-death journey
item.description: “I really just hope I made 13-year-old me lying in that hospital bed proud,” Canter said.

item.title: 1 resident killed in north Littleton apartment fire
item.description: One person was killed in a fire at a north Littleton apartment complex late Tuesday night, South Metro Fire Rescue officials said.

item.title: Guide company leading group caught in deadly avalanche warned of snow conditions days before incident
item.description: In a video posted to social media, the company urged people to "use extra caution" due to the avalanche danger.

item.title: Colorado aims to end 3-point drought against Oklahoma State
item.description: Tad Boyle described the finishing sequence of last week’s overtime loss at BYU as a “make-miss” scenario. BYU hit its shots at crunch time. The Buffaloes did not.

item.title: Former Broncos general manager Neal Dahlen, seven-time Super Bowl winner, dies at 85
item.description: "He was a man of few words. But he has a big legacy."

item.title: Colorado abortion assistance fund reports record year, with 40% of patients it helped from Texas
item.description: Nearly 40% of the $1.74 million spent on abortion procedures last year went to help Texans, according to the Cobalt Abortion Fund -- second only to Coloradans, who received about 48% of that money.

item.title: Rockies embrace ‘Camp Schaeffer’ as franchise tries new methods to turn things around
item.description: It was time for what the ultra-detailed spring training schedule called T.T.G. (Talking The Game).

item.title: Sean Payton expected to hire Ronald Curry as Broncos’ WR coach, sources say
item.description: Broncos head coach Sean Payton is hiring Ronald Curry as his new wide receivers coach, sources say. Curry interviewed for Denver's OC job earlier in the offseason and worked for Payton in New Orleans.

item.title: Nuggets to sign former CU Buffs star KJ Simpson to 2-way contract
item.description: The Nuggets are planning to sign KJ Simpson to a two-way contract after converting Spencer Jones to a standard deal.
